summary:
Implemented the window title setting in the repository, verified by reading only; no tests run, nothing installed, nothing committed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType; ControlCode union now admits Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatting entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL; added Control.title(title) returning an unstyled Control wrapping one title control, with docstring summary and Args entry.
- rich/console.py: added set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor. Writes Control.title when is_terminal and returns True; otherwise returns False. Docstring notes Rich cannot restore titles.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: SET_WINDOW_TITLE dispatches to term.set_title(title) using the control's second item. No new imports.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased "### Added" bullet linking PR 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on win32), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only, mocked term).

Interpretation choices: "buffers only when show_cursor is true" read as the same is_terminal gate show_cursor uses. Changelog URL assumes the canonical github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200 form.

Unverified: Black formatting at 88 characters (checked line lengths by eye only) and the test outcomes.
